$comment: Wall geometry (portrait 1404x1872), read by tesserae/paint/routine.js (Tesserae code element and /sim). Home flows top to bottom inside `pad`: the top part holds the date and buttons, the weather band, then TODAY beside TO DO (up to `todoSlots` rows of urgent list items); it is as tall as it needs, at most `home.topH`, with TODAY / TO DO growing up to x1.3 to fill it; the AGENDA takes the rest (whole days only); a quiet footer sits in the bottom padding. The routines screen (`routinesSlot` opens it; `memberSlots` are its child tabs) shows one child's checklist: variants size its rows (rows shrink evenly to fit); the whole row is a step's tap target. `lists` sizes the lists screen (up to `slots` rows shared between the first two lists); `navSlot` is the Lists/Back button's tap slot; `planSlot` is the old baby plan button (older frames only). `plan` sizes the baby's plan screen (read only; rows shrink to fit).
